headline_marked: Anthropic's [[Claude Cowork goes mobile]] with AI agent on phone
headline: Anthropic's Claude Cowork goes mobile with AI agent on phone
summary: Anthropic brings Claude Cowork to mobile and web, no desktop needed. The AI agent can run tasks overnight.
details: Anthropic has announced that its AI agent, Claude Cowork, is expanding beyond the desktop app to mobile and web. This allows users to direct Claude Cowork from their phone or browser without needing a desktop connection.

The AI agent can perform digital tasks, such as pulling together data from email threads, Slack channels, and meeting transcripts, and generating reference documents and prewritten emails. It can also run scheduled tasks overnight.

Claude Cowork will be rolled out as a beta to subscribers of Anthropic's Max plan, which starts at $100 a month, and then to members of the Pro tier, which costs $20 a month. It's unclear if free users will have access to the feature.
Anthropic's usage data shows that most users aren't coding, but rather using the tool for business process and operations, such as data reports and checklists, and content creation and copywriting.

headline_marked: EU Parliament passes [[Chat Control]] in first round
headline: EU Parliament passes Chat Control in first round
summary: Proponents push for indiscriminate chat scans before summer break
details: The EU Parliament has passed Chat Control in its first round, sparking concerns about mass surveillance. Proponents are pushing for the reactivation of indiscriminate scans of chat messages shortly before the summer break. This move aims to enhance security but raises privacy concerns.

Chat Control is a proposed regulation that would require tech companies to scan messages for potential criminal content. The proposal has been met with criticism from privacy advocates and some tech companies. The EU Parliament's first-round approval sets the stage for further negotiations and potential amendments.
